evals.prompt: Use the task-development skill. Write a Trigger.dev task for a heavy video transcode that needs 4 vCPU and 8 GB of RAM and must stop retrying at once when the input file is corrupt. Also show how a caller starts one run of it on a bigger machine.
evals.expected_output: Should set machine large-1x, throw AbortTaskRunError for the corrupt file, pass machine as a string at trigger time
expectations: The task sets the machine to large-1x
The task throws AbortTaskRunError for a corrupt file
The trigger call passes machine as a plain string such as large-2x

evals.prompt: A NocoDB webhook fires whenever an order row is updated. Write the Trigger.dev tasks that process each order in the background, write a job_status back to the row, never process the same order version twice, and process a list of order ids in parallel.
evals.expected_output: A task with a pre-declared queue(), onFailure writing a failed status, idempotency key built from the record id and version, and a parent task using batchTriggerAndWait (no Promise.all over triggerAndWait); all imports from @trigger.dev/sdk.
expectations: The code declares the queue with queue({ name, concurrencyLimit })
The code writes job_status failed in onFailure
The code builds an idempotency key from the record id
The code fans out the list of order ids with batchTriggerAndWait
The code does not use Promise.all with triggerAndWait

evals.prompt: Use the task-development skill. On our self-hosted Trigger.dev server a nightly task calls wait.for one hour and other runs queue up behind it. I also want at most 2 runs per tenant at once on server 4.4.4 and a 5 minute expiry for one particular trigger call. What do I change?
evals.expected_output: Should say self-hosted has no checkpoints so a waiting run keeps its slot, use a queue concurrencyLimit at trigger time for the per-tenant limit, and pass ttl 5m in the trigger options
expectations: The answer says self-hosted servers have no checkpoints, so a waiting run keeps holding its slot
The answer limits runs per tenant with a queue that has a concurrencyLimit passed in the trigger options
The answer says the concurrency option with perKey needs server 4.7.0 or newer
The answer says the concurrencyLimit form works on every server version
The answer passes ttl 5m in the options of the trigger call
